# Testing and Release

Read `docs/11-TESTING-STRATEGY.md`, `docs/17-ACCEPTANCE-CRITERIA.md` and `docs/engineering/PHASE-STATUS.md`. Run focused tests, report exact output and distinguish mocks from live integrations. Do not advance until acceptance criteria, review and human approval are satisfied.
